title: Administrator
description:
Are you an experienced School Administrator looking for a new challenge?
Aspire People are currently recruiting for School Administrators to work in local Primary and Secondary Schools. It is essential that applicants have previous school administration experience and ideally be proficient on SIMS and/or Arbor.
You must also be willing to work on a temporary basis and work between the hours of 8:00a.m. - 4:30p.m. There will be full time and part time positions available throughout the School year, which run for varying lengths of time.
There may also be an opportunity to move to a permanent contract within the Schools, although this is not guaranteed.
As a School Administrator your day to day responsibilities will include but not limited to:
Inputting details onto SIMS/Arbor
Answering phones and taking messages
Typing of letters and memos
Filing, faxing and photocopying
Dealing with parents and pupils
You must be:
Proactive
Hardworking
Used to working to strict deadlines
Not afraid to take on new tasks
Able to multi-task
Outgoing and have a friendly personality
Whether you are seeking temporary or permanent work, I will be able to assist you in finding the perfect position. I offer excellent rates of pay and I will be on hand to offer support throughout assignments.
You will be required to fully register with us including providing right to work documents along with obtaining an Enhanced Child Workforce DBS that will be processed by us but comes at a cost of 57.49 (unless you already have one registered on the update service). Please only apply if you are able to do this.
I am keen to speak to experienced School Administrators who are interested in working in a forward-thinking school. Please apply above and I will be in touch in due course. Alternatively, if you know of anybody who might be interested in this position then we offer generous referral fees!
If you are interested in finding out more about Aspire People visit our website at (url removed)
Please note that applicants must have a DBS on the update service, or be willing to pay 57.49 for a new one to be processed
Aspire People Limited provides services as an Education Agency and an Education Employment Business. Aspire People is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of pupils and expects every candidate to share this commitment. Placements are subject, to appropriate Child Protection screening, including checks with former employers and the Disclosure and Barring Checks.

title: Facilities Coordinator
description:

The organisation operates in the Not For Profit sector in Walsall.

Description

- Monitor building needs and arrange appropriate facilities services when required.
- Maintain clear records of facilities requests, planned work and completed actions.
- Manage facilities queries and provide timely updates to relevant colleagues.
- Coordinate access, room set-up and practical arrangements for workplace activities.
- Check that shared spaces and facilities are presented appropriately for daily use.
- Work with internal contacts and external providers to resolve facilities issues efficiently.
- Support the smooth running of Secretarial & Business Support activities through effective facilities coordination.

Profile

A successful 'Facilities Coordinator' should have:
- Experience of coordinating day-to-day facilities activities.
- Ability to manage facilities requests and keep accurate records.
- Confidence arranging practical workplace services and site requirements.
- Experience liaising with colleagues and external service providers.
- Ability to organise competing facilities tasks and follow actions through.
- A clear and practical approach to resolving building and workspace queries.

Job Offer
- Fixed-term contract as a Facilities Coordinator.
- Salary of 28,800 to 32000, dependent on the level of experience.
- Based in Walsall.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

description:

title: Service Administrator
description:
Alma Personnel are pleased to announce we are looking for an organised, proactive and reliable Service Administrator to join our clients' team on a full time, permanent basis to provide essential administrative support to the service department.

The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring the smooth and efficient running of daily service operations, supporting field engineers, coordinating service schedules and maintaining accurate records.

Job Duties of a Service Administrator:-
- Organise engineer schedules and allocate planned maintenance work to ensure customer requirements are met and resources are used effectively.
- Create and maintain customer service agreements, ensuring records are accurate and contract information is kept up to date.
- Arrange statutory and other required thorough examinations, track completion dates, maintain associated records and coordinate follow-up actions where issues are identified.
- Prepare customer invoices using completed service documentation, checking information carefully before processing.
- Review timesheets and job reports, resolve discrepancies and ensure all relevant paperwork is completed and filed correctly.
- Monitor work that cannot be charged to customers, check that the necessary approvals are in place and refer items requiring further review to management.
- Support the service team by taking breakdown requests, recording new jobs on the system and ensuring urgent work is appropriately prioritised.
- Respond to telephone calls and enquiries professionally, pass information to the relevant colleagues and help keep customers informed about service arrangements.
- Maintain organised electronic and paper records, update staff holiday information, monitor outstanding paperwork and assist with general departmental administration.
- Provide reception and telephone cover when required, welcome visitors, distribute incoming correspondence and prepare outgoing post.
- Keep track of scheduled and outstanding work, chase missing job sheets or reports, and highlight delays or issues to the relevant team members.
- Work closely with service engineers, the Service Controller, management and other departments to ensure information is shared effectively and work is completed on time.

The successful candidate will ideally have:-
- Experience in an administration, coordination or customer service role.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage several tasks at once.
- Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to record keeping.
- Clear and professional communication skills.
- Good computer skills and confidence using Microsoft Office and administrative systems.
- The ability to work independently while contributing positively to a team.
- A practical, flexible approach to resolving queries and meeting deadlines.

If you feel you are suitable for this role, please apply now stating why!

title: Service Controller
description:

- Do you have a track record within a service administration, service co-ordination or similar capacity?
- Do you have experience in scheduling and planning maintenance work or service visits for Engineers?
- Are you looking to join a business who truly care for, nurture and develop their people?

A nationwide service provider to the vehicle fleet industry with an enviable reputation spanning 50 years is now looking for a Service Controller to join their centre for excellence for double decks in Oldbury, West Midlands.

As Service Controller you will be part of the service administration team taking pre-planned maintenance bookings from customers and planning and scheduling of these; speaking to customers to arrange follow up visits and booking them in; interacting with Service Engineers and processing Engineer job sheets / work reports; changing the job status on internal system and ensuring all inputted data is always correct and taking ownership in service improvement initiatives and cost control.

This position would suit someone who is commercially astute and has a track record of working as a Service Controller, Service Co-ordinator, Service Administration or similar capacity ideally within an engineering or technical based business and now looking to progress their career within service operations.

You will also demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills, a strong attention to detail; be able to interface with people at all levels and be IT proficient including the use of Office 365 including Word and Excel.

Working hours are 40 hours per week Monday to Friday 8am 5pm with a 1 hour lunchbreak.

You will be working for a business who truly care for, nurture and develop their people with proof of family members across 3 generations working for the business.

title: Medical Receptionist

Main duties and responsibilities:welcome patients and visitors in a friendly, professional and courteous manner Answer incoming telephone calls and deal with patient enquiries efficiently and sensitively. Book, amend and cancel appointments using the practice clinical system - EMIS web Assist patients wiht accessing appropriate services and care navigation. Process patient requests, including prescriptions, test results and general enquiries, in accordance with practice procedures Managing incoming correspondence, emails and administrative tasks. Maintain accurate patient records and ensure confidentiality at all times Use digital systems, including Accurx, to support patient communication. Liaise effectively with GPs, nurses and other members of the practice team. Deal calmly and professionally with challenging situations. Job Summary Little London Surgery is seeking a friendly, enthusiastic and reliable Medical Receptionist to join our busy and supportive team. The successful candidate will provide a welcoming, efficient and professional service to patients, both face-to-face and over the telephone. As a first point of contact, the receptionist helps patients access appropriate assistance and healthcare services. The role requires excellent communication skills, compassion, flexibility and the ability to remain calm and organised in a busy working environment. Welcome patients and visitors in a friendly, courteous and professional manner. Answer telephone calls promptly and manage patient enquiries efficiently. Book, amend and cancel appointments using EMIS Web. Support patients through effective care navigation, directing them to the most appropriate service. Deal sensitively and professionally with patients who may be distressed, anxious or frustrated. Maintain patient confidentiality and dignity at all times. Support the smooth running of clinics and daily appointment schedules. Ensure information is accurately recorded and communicated to the appropriate team members. Work collaboratively with GPs, nurses, healthcare assistants and administrative colleagues. Communicate effectively with patients, colleagues and external healthcare providers. Participate in team meetings, training and practice development activities. Provide flexible support to colleagues during busy periods and staff absences. Comply with GDPR, confidentiality and information governance requirements. Recognise and appropriately escalate safeguarding concerns. Follow practice policies relating to health and safety, infection prevention and control, and equality and diversity. Report incidents, concerns and significant events in accordance with practice procedures.
